name: Sanatorium
source:
The reason why I came here.
I was scared, I was no good. That's why I came here.
I was looking for various hospitals and finally I arrived "here".

A quiet building in an open area beyond the birch forest.

―― “Here” was my last hope.
translation:
我来到这里的理由。
因为害怕，因为自己不行，所以，我来到了这里。
找过许多医院，最后，终于来到“这里”。

白桦林的另一端，开阔的地方，伫立着一栋安静的建筑。

——“这里”，是我最后的希望。
